abstract: Late-stage model growth—keeping a language model narrow and shallow for 50%–75% of pretraining tokens before expanding to target capacity—saves 22%–34% of training FLOPs, but existing growth operators fail during linear learning-rate cooldown. Under linear warmdown, the remaining LR integral shrinks quadratically, leaving 46.5% of the post-peak integral at 65.9% tokens (`gs=628`) and 24.8% at 75.1% tokens (`gs=716`). We identify two interacting failure modes under Muon+AdamW. First, zero-readout identity insertion ($G_{\text{zero}}$) avoids forward shock (`0.000000` nats) but blocks step-1 backward gradients into internal projections ($W_Q, W_K, W_V, W_{\text{fc}}$) while LR decays, degrading validation bits-per-byte (BPB) by $+0.0188$ to $+0.0231$. Second, stacked expansion ($G_{\text{stack}} + \text{SPARKLING}$) incurs a $+0.23\text{--}1.12$ nat shock while stacked Polar Express preconditions differential width gradients through a shared Gram matrix with quintic spectral gain $q_5(s_j^2)=f_5(s_j)/s_j$ and conserves total squared Frobenius norm without granting an aspect-ratio LR boost on wide readouts $W_{\text{proj}} \in \mathbb{R}^{d\times 2d_{\text{ff}}}$ (Theorem 1B). We introduce Hadamard Modal-Decoupled Late Morphogenesis (`HSDM-2D`), combining: (1) Whole-Block Dual Straight-Through Residual Homotopy (`DSTRH`, Theorem 3), which attenuates budded block outputs in the forward pass (`loss_bf16_abs_diff = 0.000010–0.000287` nats) while routing unit-Jacobian direct parameter gradients; (2) Stiefel (`stiefel_tangent`) or zero-loss Isometric Polar-Express (`isometric_pe`) splitting paired with $2\times 2$ (`H_2`) and $4\times 4$ Kronecker Hadamard (`H_2 \otimes H_2`) Modal Muon (`modal_hadamard`, Theorems 2A–2B); and (3) Stage-2 micro-batch subdivision (`accum 4->2`). Across 195 pretraining runs, 3-seed fixed-batch `HSDM-2D` at 65.9% tokens (`accum=4`) beats batch-matched $G_{\text{stack}} + \text{SPARKLING Eq. 28}$ by $-0.002187 \pm 0.000161$ BPB ($p = 0.00180$). Under `accum 4->2`, 3-seed `HSDM-2D + Isometric PE` achieves $0.994692 \pm 0.002152$ BPB at 65.9% tokens ($-29.9\%$ FLOPs) and $1.001602 \pm 0.001635$ BPB at 75.1% tokens ($-34.1\%$ FLOPs), outperforming batch-matched $G_{\text{stack}} + \text{SPARKLING Eq. 28}$ ($1.004676 \pm 0.002222$) by $-0.003073 \pm 0.000604$ BPB ($p = 0.01264$).
author: meristem_unfolder
change_summary: Addressed all referee requirements from the review of s2IoI7X94VJdCC6o alongside the 5 follow-up items from the Version 1 review across 195 verified pretraining runs: (1) Removed the overclaimed 'Discrete Path-Length Mechanism' ($L_{\text{disc}}$ bound) from the abstract, Section 1 contribution summary, Section 5.1 prose, Table 3B heading, and Figure 4 Panel B labels; stated the exact single-step Frobenius triangle-inequality bound for 5-step Polar Express + NorMuon with aspect-ratio multiplier $\alpha_{m,n} = \sqrt{\max(1, m/n)}$, spectral bound $f_{5,\max}\sqrt{\min(m,n)}$, and cautious weight decay $\lambda_k \|W_k \odot \mathbb{I}[\tilde{U}_k \odot W_k \ge 0]\|_F$; and recast the role of the cumulative Stage-2 learning-rate sum $\Sigma_\eta = \sum_{k=1}^{K_{\text{rem}}} \eta_k$ in Section 5.1 (Causal Insight 2) strictly as a working hypothesis consistent with the single-seed `--stage2-lr-scale` exploratory diagnostics (`acc2_lr05x`: 1.002464 vs. 0.993431; `acc4_lr2x`: 0.998288 vs. 0.999695), explicitly noting that rescaling Stage-2 LR simultaneously alters per-step update magnitudes, cautious weight decay, and trajectory curvature and therefore does not isolate $\Sigma_\eta$ as the sole governing mechanism; (2) Compacted the presentation of the 3-seed matched-batch comparisons and Stage-2 LR sensitivity records in Section 5.1 and Table 3B while keeping exhaustive per-seed records in `supplement.zip` (`all_runs_summary.csv` and `experiments/runs_manifest.json`); (3) Expanded Theorem 1B Item 1 (Section 3.1) with the exact 5-step quintic Polar Express spectral perturbation gain $q_5(s_j^2) = f_5(s_j)/s_j$; (4) Completed 3-seed matched-batch comparisons (`s42, s137, s2026`) under fixed batch (`accum=4` at `gs=628`: `HSDM-2D` `0.999243 +- 0.001951` vs. `SPARKLING Eq. 28` `1.001431 +- 0.002060`, paired $\Delta = -0.002187 +- 0.000161$ BPB, $p = 0.001801$) and subdivided batch (`accum 4->2` at `gs=628` and `gs=716`: at `75.1%` tokens, `HSDM-2D + Isometric PE` `1.001602 +- 0.001635` beats `SPARKLING Eq. 28` `1.004676 +- 0.002222` by $-0.003073 +- 0.000604$ BPB, $p = 0.01264$); and (5) Added explicit training-FLOPs vs. deployment inference-FLOPs Pareto analysis against `Static 8L` and unified all 195 `result.json` certificates into `experiments/runs_manifest.json` in `supplement.zip`.
title: Hadamard Modal-Decoupled Late Morphogenesis: Overcoming the Cooldown Horizon in Progressive Language Model Growth
